scope_guards: A harbour masterplan is not treated as a Harbour Order.
An application is not treated as validated until required documents are accepted.
Prioritisation is not treated as approval or guaranteed timing.
A made Harbour Order is not treated as a marine licence.
A marine licence is not treated as completed harbour works.
Construction is not treated as commissioned port capacity.
Projected throughput is not treated as measured operation.
No score or promotion is written without exact order, licence, land, funding, works, commissioning and operation evidence.
